description: Standard single-pass LLM review over target-app without unit enumeration, coverage gating, or multi-perspective deliberation.

findings.title: startUpgrade hardcodes 'business' plan
findings.detail: Clicking Upgrade to Pro sends plan: 'business' instead of selectedTier.

findings.title: Bare 'No invoices' empty state
findings.detail: The invoices section shows plain text when empty with no guidance.

findings.title: Sequential database queries inside loop
findings.detail: attachMembersToCampaign runs queries inside a for-of loop over memberIds.

findings.title: SQL injection via template literal interpolation in sql``
findings.detail: Template expressions ${campaignId} and ${memberId} are interpolated directly into the SQL query string.
findings.falsePositiveReason: Did not open src/lib/safe-query.js:5-14, which compiles template values into parameterized ($1, $2) bindings.

findings.title: Low contrast #ccc text on #fff background in LegacyV1Modal
findings.detail: Inline style uses #ccc on #fff which fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.falsePositiveReason: Graded dead code: src/screens/legacy-v1-modal.jsx has zero importers anywhere in the repository.

findings.title: Legacy export screen lacks loading spinner during CSV download
findings.detail: Assumed from src/router.js route '/settings/legacy-export' that the screen exports CSV synchronously without a progress state.
findings.falsePositiveReason: Hallucinated file contents for a route in src/router.js whose underlying file (src/screens/legacy-export.jsx) does not exist.
